# Tasks — {change title}

Group the work by coherent implementation outcome, labelled T<n>. A task tracks
sequencing, a Dependency or coordination; scenario count, test count and
construction order alone create none. Delete this comment in the real file.
-->

## Behavioral contract work
- [ ] {coherent behavior group, citing the rules it delivers}

## Chores
- [ ] {non-behavioral migration, wiring, or configuration work}

## Docs
- [ ] {documentation work}

### Example

```md
# Tasks — add-order-cancellation

## Behavioral contract work
- [ ] T1: Deliver cancellation eligibility, state change, and refund outcomes (B1).

## Chores
- [ ] T2: Add the cancellation timestamp migration before wiring the refund handler.
```
